gates.title: Clean build
gates.remaining: Pass the complete clean-checkout checks at the final integrated revision, including the online server.

gates.title: Complete campaign
gates.remaining: Complete epochs, several human-playable victory paths and strategically engaging long campaigns.

gates.title: AI competency
gates.remaining: Retain reviewed AI corrections, complete missing strategic systems and prove representative long soaks and disrupted logistics.

gates.title: Giant scale
gates.remaining: Verify Huge 100+ turns and Legendary stress with deterministic hashes and bounded retained memory.

gates.title: Save integrity
gates.remaining: Finish integrated replay/recovery coverage and the remaining real-browser durability proof.

gates.title: Combat
gates.remaining: Complete combat breadth and integrated player/AI land, siege and naval acceptance.

gates.title: Research and magic depth
gates.remaining: Complete rituals, items, paths, sacred/occult play, cross-system unlocks and counterplay.

gates.title: Diplomacy
gates.remaining: Finish rule-bearing treaties, client relationships, broader negotiations and server validation.

gates.title: Settlement conquest
gates.remaining: Finish supported liberation/client outcomes and prove distinct saved consequences with AI understanding.

gates.title: UX at scale
gates.remaining: Complete delegation and verify an accessible mature realm with 100+ armies.

gates.title: Content
gates.remaining: Meet all accepted gameplay/content targets and validate references, localization and release assets.

gates.title: Performance
gates.remaining: Publish current isolated turn, AI, route, transfer, map and archive results with no severe open regression.

gates.title: Browser support
gates.remaining: Certify current Chromium, Firefox and Safari/WebKit where practical against the release candidate.

gates.title: Multiplayer
gates.remaining: Build and verify real authoritative online campaigns with two-client coverage.

gates.title: Release hygiene
gates.remaining: Finish the release-wide placeholder, license, version, error-path and production-debug audit.

stages.title: Playable foundations delivered
stages.description: Checked items are bounded, implemented checkpoints. Their wider 1.0 systems still have work below.

stages.title: Complete the playable systems
stages.description: Client obligations and unification, magical discovery, standing orders and supply now have playable portions. Complete their remaining strategic choices, coordinated logistics and integrated verification in the order recorded by the development workflow.

stages.title: Build the missing release systems
stages.description: Accepted 1.0 work with no complete playable implementation. These are release obligations, not newly added promises.

stages.title: Prove the release together
stages.description: Verify the final integrated revision. Earlier successful checkpoints and deployment do not clear these gates.
